blurb.text: A Languedoc-Roussillon appellation for red, rosé and white wines, usually blends of several grapes. Reds can use Syrah, Grenache, Carignan, Mourvèdre and Cinsault, and whites Marsanne, Roussanne and Vermentino. It has had AOC protection since 1982.
